stem.text: Which feature of collagen enables it to fulfil a structural role in skin and in tendons?

A.text: Adjacent collagen molecules are linked by ester bonds.

B.text: Collagen fibres form layers with the fibres in different directions.

C.text: Collagen molecules are formed as a triple helix of polypeptide chains.

D.text: Polypeptide chains of collagen are tightly folded into compact shapes.
